the effects of retinal detachment on the expression of the FGF receptor 1 (FGFR1), its ligand FGF2 and on AP-1 transcription factor expression in Müller and RPE cell nuclei.

the activation of FGF receptor 1 (FGFR1) and the subsequent expression of AP-1 proteins are essential for the reactive changes of Müller cells after retinal detachment (RD).

the expression of FGFR1 and the activation of its downstream targets, including AP-1 and c-fos, are increased in reactive retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) and Müller cells following retinal detachment (RD).

The main takeaway from our work is that
the FGF signaling pathway is important for the activation of AP-1 in Müller cells and RPE cells in response to retinal detachment.
the FGF signaling pathway is activated in Müller cells in response to retinal detachment and that FGF2 is a key player in this pathway.
